# Tier 1 golden values for the ws-world toy generator (TP-006, ADR 0016).
#
# Must match exactly on every platform (Linux x86-64 and macOS arm64 CI).
# Generated by an independent Python implementation of SipHash-2-4, FNV-1a,
# and the ADR 0016 derivations, not by the Rust code under test. Changing a
# value changes procedural identities, which breaks saves: an update needs
# a written justification, Product Owner approval, and a dataset or
# generator version bump (docs/process/testing-policy.md section 2).
#

# resident <seed> <index> <slot> <id>
# target <seed> <resident id> <k> <building index>
#   the building the resident's k-th draw sends it to, starting at home
